activeQuestion.prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [144].
activeQuestion.promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格 [144] 的字詞或句子。

options.text: All display sets must be returned within two days.
options.zh: 所有展示組必須兩天內歸還。
options.whyZh: 文中提供免費展示組，未建立限時借用，且不能解釋小卡。

options.text: Customers may change the color after delivery.
options.zh: 顧客可在交貨後更改顏色。
options.whyZh: 沒有此政策，也不承接小卡用途。

options.text: The card also explains how to care for the ceramics.
options.zh: 小卡也說明如何保養陶瓷。
options.whyZh: 承接 information card 並補充資訊，後句 this card 指涉連貫。

options.text: Our factory no longer produces bowls.
options.whyZh: 與此系列和展示組均含碗的敘述矛盾。

group.title: New ceramic collection
group.passage:
Retail Partner Bulletin

Stonebridge Ceramics is pleased to introduce the Meadow collection, a range of handmade cups and bowls in three soft colors. Each piece is finished individually, so slight variations in shape and shade should be [143] ____. These differences are a feature of the collection rather than a manufacturing fault.

Advance orders will open on September 8. Retailers may request one complimentary display set, which includes a cup, a bowl, and a small information card describing the production process. [144] ____ We recommend placing this card beside the display to help customers understand why no two pieces are exactly alike.

The first shipments are scheduled for October. Orders received by September 20 will be dispatched first, [145] ____ later orders may not arrive until November. Please note that the introductory wholesale price applies only to orders of twenty-four pieces or more. Smaller orders will be charged at the standard rate. Our sales team can provide a detailed quotation and confirm [146] ____ before you place an order.
group.passageZh:
零售合作夥伴公告

Stonebridge Ceramics 欣然推出 Meadow 系列，包含三種柔和色彩的手工杯碗。每件商品皆獨立修整，因此形狀和色澤略有差異是 [143] ____。這些差異是系列特色，並非製造瑕疵。

九月八日起開放預訂。零售商可申請一組免費展示品，內含一只杯、一只碗和一張說明製作流程的小卡。[144] ____ 建議將小卡放在展示品旁，協助顧客理解為何沒有兩件完全相同。

首批預定十月出貨。最遲在九月二十日收到的訂單將優先寄出，[145] ____ 較晚收到的訂單可能要到十一月才會送達。上市批發優惠僅適用於二十四件以上的訂單；較小訂單依標準價格計費。業務團隊可提供詳細報價，並在您下單前確認 [146] ____。
